name: Create Weather Dashboard & Thermometer
description:
Create a 2-page custom weather tracking flipchart in ActivInspire.

Page 1 - Dashboard:
- Title: 'Today's Weather'
- Create a Thermometer Diagram using the Shape tool: Draw a Circle (bulb) at the bottom and a tall Rectangle (stem) extending upward from it.
- Add text labels next to the stem for these specific degrees: '0', '32', '50', '70', '100'.
- Add weather condition text: 'Sunny' and 'Rainy'.
- Add a simple icon next to each condition (e.g., a Circle for sun, a Rectangle/Triangle for rain).

Page 2 - Weekly Log:
- Title: 'Weekly Log'
- Add headers for the school week: 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'.
- Draw a horizontal Line shape under the days to form a header row.

Save the file to: /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/weather_tracker.flipchart
